h: First Lady Remi Tinubu says she hopes to leave Aso Rock in 2031 to a Nigeria she can enjoy
p: Remi Tinubu has spoken about when she expects to leave the presidential villa, saying she hopes to hand over in 2031 to a country that is more comfortable to live in. The remark has drawn wide comment as the 2027 campaign begins.
more: Her words are being read as a sign the family expects two terms in office.
Opposition figures have yet to respond directly.
Supporters say she was speaking about hopes for a better country.
